metadata.title: Configuration
metadata.description: This section allows administrators to define and manage system-wide settings that apply across the entire platform. These global parameters control core functionalities, security policies, performance thresholds, and other critical configurations.

admin_config.mineru_api_description: When enabled, the system will prioritize using the MinerU API for document parsing to improve parsing quality and speed.
admin_config.mineru_api_token_tips: Tips: The official MinerU API Token is valid for 14 days, please replace it before it expires.
admin_config.use_doc_ray_description: When enabled, the system will use doc-ray for document parsing.
admin_config.use_markitdown_description: When enabled, the system will use markitdown for document parsing.
admin_config.system_default_quota_description: These default quotas help maintain system stability, prevent resource abuse, and ensure fair allocation across users or applications.
admin_config.core_chunking_description: Document parsing chunk parameters that affect retrieval precision and context coherence
admin_config.cache_settings_description: LLM call cache settings to reduce redundant API calls
admin_config.kg_settings_description: Controls entity extraction, chunking, and merging behavior during knowledge graph construction
admin_config.kg_force_llm_summary_on_merge: Force LLM Summary on Merge Threshold
admin_config.kg_entity_types_placeholder: Enter entity type and press Enter to add
admin_config.kg_relation_types_placeholder: Enter relation type and press Enter to add
admin_config.hint_kg_relation_types: Allowed relation keywords for knowledge graph extraction. When set, LLM picks only from this list, enabling ontology constraints
admin_config.hint_max_graph_nodes: Maximum number of nodes displayed in the knowledge graph visualization. Higher values show more nodes but may degrade rendering performance. Range 1-10000
admin_config.parent_child_chunking_description: When enabled, documents are split into large parent chunks (preserving context) and small child chunks (for precise matching). When a child chunk is matched during retrieval, the full parent chunk is returned as context.
admin_config.parent_chunk_separator_hint: Delimiter to split the document into parent chunks, e.g. ##. Leave empty to use title hierarchy.
admin_config.child_chunk_separator_hint: Delimiter to split parent chunks into child chunks, e.g. \n\n (paragraph). Leave empty for semantic splitting.
admin_config.preprocess_collapse_whitespace: Collapse consecutive whitespace (spaces, newlines, tabs → single space)
admin_config.hint_chunk_size: Controls retrieval granularity. Smaller chunks improve precision but may lose context; larger chunks preserve more context at the cost of precision
admin_config.hint_chunk_overlap_size: Token overlap between adjacent chunks. Proper overlap prevents key information from being split across chunk boundaries
admin_config.hint_cache_enabled: When enabled, caches LLM responses to avoid redundant API calls and reduce costs
admin_config.hint_cache_ttl: Cache entry lifetime in seconds. Expired entries are automatically cleared and re-fetched from the LLM
admin_config.hint_parent_child_enabled: Split documents into large parent chunks (context) and small child chunks (precise retrieval). Matched child returns full parent content
admin_config.hint_parent_chunk_size: Parent chunk size determines context richness returned to the LLM. Larger = more context but may dilute key information
admin_config.hint_child_chunk_size: Child chunks are used for precise semantic matching. Smaller = more precise but may fragment meaning
admin_config.hint_child_chunk_overlap: Token overlap between adjacent child chunks to prevent information cutoff at semantic boundaries
admin_config.hint_parent_chunk_separator: Recommended: ## to split by Markdown headings. Leave empty to auto-split by document title hierarchy
admin_config.hint_child_chunk_separator: Recommended: \n\n to split by paragraphs. Leave empty for automatic semantic splitting
admin_config.hint_preprocess_collapse_whitespace: Merge consecutive spaces, newlines, and tabs into a single space to clean document formatting noise
admin_config.hint_preprocess_remove_urls_emails: Remove all URLs and email addresses from text to prevent irrelevant strings from affecting embeddings
admin_config.hint_kg_chunk_token_size: Token size for LightRAG document chunking, affecting entity extraction granularity
admin_config.hint_kg_chunk_overlap_token_size: Token overlap between adjacent graph chunks to prevent entities from being lost at boundaries
admin_config.hint_kg_entity_extract_max_gleaning: Max gleaning rounds for entity extraction. 0 = no gleaning; higher values extract more thoroughly but take longer
admin_config.hint_kg_llm_model_max_async: Max concurrent LLM calls during graph construction. Increase for speed, decrease to reduce API load
admin_config.hint_kg_cosine_threshold: Minimum cosine similarity for vector matching. Higher = more precise results but may miss relevant content
admin_config.hint_kg_max_batch_size: Max items per batch during graph processing. Larger batches improve throughput but use more memory
admin_config.hint_kg_summary_max_tokens: Max tokens for entity and relationship summaries. Controls summary detail level
admin_config.hint_kg_force_llm_summary_on_merge: When entity count reaches this threshold, force LLM summarization instead of simple concatenation
admin_config.hint_kg_entity_types: Entity types to extract in the knowledge graph. Add custom types as tags to control extraction scope
admin_config.hint_use_mineru: When enabled, prioritize MinerU API for PDF parsing with better table and formula recognition
admin_config.hint_mineru_api_token: Official MinerU API token, valid for 14 days. Replace before expiry
admin_config.hint_mineru_api_base_url: MinerU API service base URL. Leave empty for cloud (https://mineru.net), or set your local instance e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8000
admin_config.hint_use_doc_ray: When enabled, use DocRay for document parsing with locally deployed advanced parsing service
admin_config.hint_use_markitdown: When enabled, use MarkItDown to convert Word/Excel files to Markdown
admin_config.ocr_asr_settings_description: Configure OCR and speech-to-text service URLs
admin_config.hint_paddleocr_host: PaddleOCR service URL for image text extraction. Leave empty to skip OCR.
admin_config.hint_whisper_host: Whisper service URL for audio transcription. Leave empty to skip speech recognition.
admin_config.hint_max_bot_count: Maximum number of bots a user can create
admin_config.hint_max_collection_count: Maximum number of knowledge base collections a user can create
admin_config.hint_max_document_count: Maximum total number of documents a user can upload
admin_config.hint_max_document_count_per_collection: Maximum number of documents allowed per collection
admin_config.mineru_api_base_url_required: Please enter the MinerU API base URL

metadata.title: API keys
metadata.description: This section allows you to securely store, update, and manage API keys for different AI services (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.). Connecting your keys enables personalized AI interactions while keeping your credentials protected.

metadata.title: Audit Logs
metadata.description: Track and review all critical system activities with Audit Logs—a detailed record of user actions, API calls, and administrative changes. Ensure transparency, security, and compliance by monitoring who did what, when, and from where.

page_collections.index_types_description: Select the AI capabilities you need, we will build corresponding indexes for your documents

index_type_VECTOR.title: Vector
index_type_VECTOR.description: Represents data (text, images, etc.) as high-dimensional vectors to enable similarity-based retrieval.

index_type_FULLTEXT.title: Fulltext
index_type_FULLTEXT.description: Indexes keywords within text using techniques like inverted indexing for exact or fuzzy

index_type_GRAPH.title: Graph
index_type_GRAPH.description: Stores data as nodes (entities) and edges (relationships), enabling complex relational

index_type_SUMMARY.title: Summary
index_type_SUMMARY.description: Indexes summaries or metadata of long documents instead of raw content for faster

index_type_VISION.title: Vision
index_type_VISION.description: Encodes visual content (images/videos) into feature vectors for content-based retrieval.

page_collections.model_settings_description: Select AI models for document processing. Different index types require different model support
page_collections.embedding_model_description: An embedding model translates data into numerical vectors that capture their semantic meaning and relationships.
page_collections.completion_model_description: A completion model is an AI that generates new content by predicting the most likely subsequent text based on a given input.
page_collections.advanced_settings_desc: Custom chunking and graph parameters. Leave empty to use system defaults.
